result:
320 DPI, confirmed above the 300+ requirement. All deliverables are complete:

- **`script.R`** — self-contained, Okabe-Ito palette/theme, `set.seed()` before matching, computes the experimental benchmark ($1,794), builds the NSW-treated + CPS-control composite, runs 6 matching specs (2 covariate sets × {1-NN no-trim, 1-NN trimmed, stratification}) plus the naive difference, all with cluster-robust SEs (clustered on matched pair/subclass) rather than an invalid nonparametric bootstrap.
- **`figures/spec-curve.png`** — one dot-and-whisker plot, 95% CIs, benchmark as a dashed reference line, naive estimate as a dotted line, 320 dpi, no title.
- **`spec-table.md`** — every spec's estimate, CI, N, and gap vs. benchmark.
- **`memo.md`** (477 words) — verdict: recovery is **favorable-specification-only** (holds under 1-NN with pre-treatment earnings included, fails under demographics-only covariates or under stratification even with the richer covariate set), siding with Smith-Todd over an unqualified reading of Dehejia-Wahba.
